content: County of Sa n Diego, Health and Human S e rvices Agency (HH SA) CalFresh Program Guide Number Page Household C o ncept 63-10 1 1 of 8 Revision Date: 04/01/20 23 Back g r o und: House hold (HH) composi t i on is use d to determi ne which indivi duals will be in cluded in the CalFresh HH. Purpose: This sectio n details t he effects HH compo sition has on determin ing eli gibili t y. The section is be ing revised to include the C alFresh definitions of el derly and di sabled along with clarificatio n of t he 165 % elde rly a nd d isabled (E/D) separate HH determina t i on ru le. The section has been reformatted and is bein g updated due to sun set revi ew. Poli c y: A Ca lFresh HH is an indivi dual o r group of indi viduals who l ive togethe r and cu st o marily pu rchase and prepa re (P&P) meals together. A H H i s determi ned by the rela t i onship that exists amo ng i t s members. Restricted relationsh ips take priori t y when determin ing H H compo sition. The customer is respon sible for provi ding compl ete and correct informatio n to determine HH composition. Do n ot deny an app lication wh en an appl icant applie s se parately but lives w ith ot h ers who must be inclu ded in the HH wi t h the ap plicant. Contin ue processing the a pplicatio n and: Inform the appli cant t h at the o t h er persons livi ng with him/her must be incl uded in the HH , an d Requ est informatio n and verificatio n of t h e other peop le in the home and con t i nue processing the appl ication for the entire HH fol lowing reg ulations as exp lained i n 63-109. If t h e applica nt f ai ls to provide the i nformation and ve rification on othe r HH members ne eded to determin e eligib ility, deny the appli cation for failure to provi de information. Note: An unaccompa nied minor expe riencing home lessness, who is not in t h e p hysical custody of a paren t or guard ian, is no t li ving with an adult who has paren t a l con t ro l over t he m, or in foster care may appl y a s the ir own HH even i f there i s n o adult in the case. 1. Defini t i ons: The follow ing are defin itions for terms t ha t w ill be used throu ghout the section: Term Definition Elderl y A HH member w ho is 60 years of age or old er. Disab led A HH member w ho receives or meets any of the follo wing: Suppl emental S e curity Income (SSI ) benefits u nder Title XVI , or disab ility or blin dness payments under Title II (Soci al Security Disabil ity Insura nce Program) of the Socia l Security Act. Disab ility retirement benefits from a g overnmental age ncy b ecause of a disab ility conside red permanen t und er Se ct i on 221(i) of the Social Securi t y Act. Interim assistan ce benefits pend ing receip t of SSI, provide d that t h e eligib ility to receive those bene f i t s is based upo n di sability or blind ness criteria which County of Sa n Diego, Health and Human S e rvices Agency (HH SA) CalFresh Program Guide Number Page Household C o ncept 63-10 1 2 of 8 are a t least as st ri ngent as tho se used u nder Title X VI of the Social Security Act. Disab ility-related medical a ssistance unde r T i t l e XIX (Medi-Cal ) of t h e Social Security Act. Disab ility-based g eneral assistan ce benefits, provided tha t the el igibil ity to receive those ben efits is based upon disa bility or blindne ss criteria wh ich are at least as stringen t as those use d under Title XVI of t he S o cial Security Act. An an nuity paymen t u nder Section 2(a)(1)(iv) of the Railroa d Retiremen t Act of 1974 a nd is determine d to be eligi ble to receive Medicare by the R ailroad Retireme nt Board ; or Sectio n 2(a)(1 )(v) of t he Rai lroad Retirement Act of 1974 and i s determined to be d isabled based u pon the criteria used under Title XVI of t he S o cial Security Act. Veteran s be nefits ba sed on a se rvice-conne ct e d or non service-conn ected disab ility rated by the Veteran's Admi nistration (VA) as total or paid as total by the VA under Title 38 o f the Un ited States Code (this incl udes veterans consid ered by the VA to need regular aid an d attendan ce or p ermanently house bound). Is a survivi ng spou se of a veteran and consi dered by t he VA to need regular aid an d a t ten dance or permane ntly housebou nd or a su rviving child o f a veteran and considere d by the VA to be perman ently in capable of sel f - suppo rt un der Title 38 of the United States Code . Is a survivi ng spouse or su rviving child of a vet e ran and considered by the VA to be en t i t l ed to compensatio n for a service-con nected d eath or pension bene f i t s for a nonservice -connected death unde r Title 38 of the United States Code and has a disabil ity conside red perma nent und er Section 221(i) of the Social Se curity Act (en t i t l ed as used in this defin ition refers to those veterans' survivin g spouse s and survivi ng child ren who are receivi ng the comp ensation or pen sion bene f i t s stated or ha ve been app roved for such payme nts, bu t a re not yet receivin g t h em). 2. Restricted H H: Restricted H H members are individ uals who live togethe r and must be con sidered as P &P meals together, even if the y clai m no t to be. R est ri ct e d H H mem bers a re re quired to b e i ncluded in the same HH. The follow ing are restricted HH me mbers in which se parate HH status cannot be ap proved: Spouse s either marrie d under ap plicabl e state law or w ho are li ving togethe r and represe nting themselve s to the commu nity as married. A person und er 2 2 years of ag e who is living wi t h thei r n atural or adoptive pare nt(s) o r steppare nt(s). When the parents of a child ha ve jo int custod y and there is equal (50/50 ) physi cal custody of a child and the living arrang ements a re that the ch ild lives with e ach pa rent an equ al numbe r o f da ys per month, HH compositio n will be de t e rmined as follow s: If the ch ild eats then the m ajority of meals in a month the c h ild m ay particip ate with the pa rent provid ing the majori t y of the meals, unless the two custodial pare nts agre e County of Sa n Diego, Health and Human S e rvices Agency (HH SA) CalFresh Program Guide Number Page Household C o ncept 63-10 1 3 of 8 with one p arent, otherwi se. an e qual nu mber of meal s with each pa rent m onthly, the first custodial parent to apply may p articipate with the child , un less the two custodial p arents agree otherw ise. A minor (other than a foster chi ld) who live s w ith and is under the pa rental control of a HH member w ho is not his or her paren t un less the minor meets one of the follo wing cond itions: Has entere d a valid marria ge Is on active duty in the U.S. armed forces Has bee n emancipa t e d by a court order Note: A mino r (other than a foster child ) is not co nsidered unde r the parental control of a HH member w hen one of the follow ing occurs: The minor s l iquid reso urces and/or inco me is suff i cient to economical ly self-support their own affairs The minor i s ap proachin g t h eir 18th birthday in the ca lendar month pr ior to applicatio n The minor come s a nd goes withou t ap proval Chil dren who resi de at a drug/alcoh ol treatment center with their pare nt. 3. Depen dent Relatio nship: If t h ere is a de penden t re lationshi p between a ny restricted HH me mbers, they must all b e includ ed in the HH. A depen dent relation ship is establish ed if any of t h e f o llowin g apply: Resid e on the same parcel of land and do not live in separate an d distinct li ving qua rt e rs. Separa t e and distinct living quarters include different buildi ngs w ith self-con t a ined living facilities, different units within the same bui lding with self-contai ned living facil ities, a nd mobile homes that are affixed to the lan d. Repe atedly using the ki t ch en, bathroom or sleep ing facilities of the other pe rson, repeatedl y i s define d as a majority of usage of any such type of facili t y. 4. Non-HH M embers: The follow ing members sho uld not be inclu ded as a member of the HH un less they P&P meals together. Non-HH membe rs who are otherwi se eli gible, may p articipate as a separa t e HH from the indi viduals they li ve with. T h e f o llowin g are considere d non-HH memb ers: Individ uals to whom a HH pro vides lodgi ng but not meals, also kno wn as roomers. Live-i n att e ndants or indi viduals who reside with a HH to provi de medical , ho usekeepin g, ch ildcare or other simi lar personal se rvices. Individ uals who sha re living qu arters and are not restricted HH memb ers. 5. Separate HH Status: Separa t e H H st a t u s ma y b e approved for the follo wing: An individ ual l iving with o t h ers who customari ly P&Ps meals separately from the other me mbers i n the home. Note: A di sabled individu al who is unabl e to P&P (who is not a restri ct ed HH membe r) their own meals but has arranged to h ave thei r food P&P se parately from those they live with, eve n if the County of Sa n Diego, Health and Human S e rvices Agency (HH SA) CalFresh Program Guide Number Page Household C o ncept 63-10 1 4 of 8 person who shop s for t he food or prepares the meals f or the disable d in dividua l li ves in the home, may claim sep arate HH status. Example Scenari o HH consists of mo m and her 30-ye ar-old severely disab led son. Mo m and son cla im t o P&P separately. Son states mom use s his money to shop for him and p repares his meal s f or hi m, si nce he is unabl e t o . Outcome Son is considere d a sepa rate HH from mom and may ha ve hi s own Ca lFresh case. An indi vidual (an d t h eir childre n if l iving with them) who is a t emp orary residen t of a shel t e r for battered pe rsons. 6. 165% Ru le for Separate HH Status for E/D HH Members: Althoug h all individ uals li ving togethe r who P&P meals toge t h er are con sidered t o be on e CalFresh HH, there is one exception . Refer to the t ab le bel ow for situa t i ons when an el derly pe rson who suffers from a disabi lity considere d permanen t und er t h e Social Securi t y Act or a non-d isease related se vere perman ent disabil ity ma y b e considere d a separate HH from those they P&P with. Note: The E/D perso n (and their spo use) may be a separate H H but a re not re quired t o be. Note: If the E/D pe rson st ates to P&P sep arately we are to accept their statemen t . title: 63-103 Filing an Application
content: County of San Diego, Health and H u m an Ser vices Agency (HHSA ) CalFresh Program Guide Number Page Fili ng an Appl ication 63-10 3 1 of 3 Revision: 06/01/20 22 Back g r o und: To ap ply for C alFresh be nefits an applica t i on must be submitted. C alFresh ap plicants must then comple t e a n interview an d provide verifica t i on of cert a in information . Purpose: This sectio n provid es guida nce on acceptable applica t i on forms, determi ning the beginn ing da t e of aid, and the processing of combo appli cations. T hi s sectio n is bein g re vised aft e r sunse t review , there are no cha nges due to state legisl ation. Poli c y: Any of the followi ng forms may be used to apply for Cal F r esh: Appli cation for CalFresh Ben efits (C F 285 ) Initial App lication for Cal F re sh, C ash-Aid, and/or Medi -Cal/Heal t h care Programs (SAWS 1) Appli cation for CalFresh, Cash -Aid, and/or Medi-Ca l/Healthcare Pro grams (SAWS 2 Pl us) Appli cation forms must be availa ble to customers at each Family Reso urce Center (FRC) lobb y. An appl ication must be accepted as l ong as it contains t he follo wing minimum requireme nts: appli cants name, address, a nd sign ature of a respo nsible househo ld (HH ) member or Autho rized Repre sentative (AR). Appli cations ma y be submitted in pe rson, by mail, online, faxed, or by ph one. Appli cations sub mitt e d with electronic or teleph onic si gnatures ar e acceptab le. Customers applyin g for multiple p rograms wil l only have to comple t e on e applica t i on and one intervi ew. 1. Publi c Assi st a nce (PA) and CalFresh App lication: An app lication sub mitt e d f o r P A sh all be con sidered a req uest for both PA and CalFresh , u nless it is determin ed otherwi se during t h e intervie w. When proce ssing a PA a nd CalFresh applica t i on, eligi bility for CalFresh benefits wil l be base d on CalFresh regulatio ns, includi ng Expedited Services (ES). If PA is deni ed, CalFresh must continu e t o be evaluated. 2. Est a blishin g t h e Beginni ng Date of Aid (BDA): The date the applica t i on is received by the county estab lishes t h e BDA. The date t he appl ication is receive d must be recorded on the appli cation. I f an applica t i on is rece ived outside of no rmal business hours, the beg inning d ate of ai d will be the ne xt bu siness day. If the ap plication i s su bmitted then the date of application will b e within regular busi ness hours, the date that the appl ication is receive d by t h e county. after regula r b usiness hou rs, the next bu siness day from the date that the applicatio n was recei ved by the county. Example : Appl ication was recei ved on Monday at 5:30 PM. D ate of a pplicatio n will be Tuesd ay. on a non -business da y, the next bu siness day from the date that the applicatio n was recei ved by the county. Example : Appl ication was submi t ted on Saturd ay at 9:30 AM. Date of app lication w ill be Mo nday. If Monday is a holi day and t h e office i s closed, the date of app lication wil l b e Tuesday. County of San Diego, Health and H u m an Ser vices Agency (HHSA ) CalFresh Program Guide Number Page Fili ng an Appl ication 63-10 3 2 of 3 Note : Regul ar business hou rs are 7AM  5PM Monday throug h F ri day. 3. Establish ing the Semi-Ann ual Report (SAR) Paymen t Peri od: The BDA establish es t he SAR pa yment period. The SAR payment period be gins the first mo nt h the customer is el igible t o re ceive bene f i t s. If the customer is not el igible to rece ive bene f i t s in t he month of appli cation, the SAR payment perio d will beg in in the second mon t h . Example: Establishing BD A and SAR C ycle Scenario Customer ap plies in Jan uary, is not eligibl e f o r b enefits in January, but is appro ved for benefits in February an d ongoin g. Outcome February 1 st is the BDA and the SAR cycle be gins in February. 4. Month of Appli cation : Eligi bility in the month of appl ication is d etermined by t he HH circumstance s as of the date of the intervie w. Exce ptions to this includ e HH that consist of t he f ol lowing i ndividu als: HH Types Refer to Strikers 63-10 1 Househo ld Concept for guid ance on determin ing elig ibility for strikers Volun t a ry Qui t 63-15 9 Voluntary Quit and the Red uction of Work E ffort for guid ance on determi ning elig ibility for customers who have volun t a ry q uit a job Resou rce T ra nsfers 63-20 1 Resource Elig ibility Determi nation for guid ance on determin ing elig ibility whe n t h ere has been a transfer of resou rces Migran t an d seasonal farmworkers that meet the destitute criteria 63-25 2 Househo lds with Migran t or Sea sonal Farmworke rs for guid ance on determi ning elig ibility for Migran t or sea sonal farmworkers that meet the destitute criteri a in the month of appl ication Catego rically Elig ible (CE) 63-12 0 Categorica l E l igibil ity (CE) f or gu idance on d etermining CalFresh e ligibi lity f o r CE HH 5. Proration o f Ben efits: Most of the time, a H H will no t get a full month s benefits in the month of appl ication, this is al so referred t o as prora t i on. CalFresh benefits are prorated f ro m the date t he appli cation wa s received and customers will be issue d be nefits for the days remainin g in the month. Refer t o section 63-1 09 Time Limits and Delays for f urthe r gu idance on timely processin g. The table below de scribes proratio n of b enefits in the month of appli cation: If Then all req uired verifica t i ons are received time ly, bene f i t s w ill be p rorated from the date the appl ication is recei ved. processi ng the app lication i s delayed b eyond 30 days due t o the fault o f the HH b ut is found e ligibl e during t h e second 30-day perio d, bene f i t s w ill be p rorated from the date the customer submi t s al l required ve rifications. County of San Diego, Health and H u m an Ser vices Agency (HHSA ) CalFresh Program Guide Number Page Fili ng an Appl ication 63-10 3 3 of 3 processi ng the app lication i s delayed b eyond 30 days du e t o the fau lt o f the cou nty, bene f i t s will be prora t e d retroactive to the da t e of the appli cation. Note: Mi grant or seasonal farmworker HHs that have a break i n aid of 30 days or less wil l not h ave their ben efits p rorated, t h ey will recei ve the full months ben efit. 6. CalFresh A p plication U sed to Apply for Medi-Ca l: Upon the return of a Cal F r esh appl ication, if the customer in dicates intere st in app lying for Medi-Cal , the information capture d on the CalFresh app lication wil l be used to complete an eligi bility determin ation for Medi-Ca l. If there is no active o r p ending Me di-Cal, colle ct the R equest for T a x House hold Information (RFTHI) from t he cu st o mer. The Med i-Cal BDA will be e st a blished up on receip t of the RFTHI. Refer to MPG 04 . 0 2.13A for f u rt h er guidan ce when processi ng a Medi-Ca l elig ibility determi nation usin g a CalFresh app lication. 7. Verificatio n Procedure for Combo A p plication s: Verificatio ns recei ved for other programs can be used to he lp d etermine eligib ility for CalFresh. Do not delay proce ssing the CalFresh appl ication while w aiting for verifications for other programs. Approve Cal F r esh a s soon as all verificatio ns ha ve be en received, even if there are pen ding verificatio ns for other programs. I f other programs are denied , continue to evaluate CalFresh eli gibility based on the origin al app lication. CalFresh ca nnot be denied for failu re to pro vide be f o re the 30 th da y even if t h e PA appl ication is denied soone r. Refer t o 63-1 17 Ve rification and Documen t a t i on for guid ance on mand atory CalFresh verificatio ns. Other Program Impacts : CalWORKs, CAPI, G R , MC Refer ences: MPP 63-300 . 2 ; MPP 63-3 01.6; MPP 63 -503; MPG 0 4.02.13A; ACWDL 01-10; ACL 15 -84; AB 59 ; SB 493 Sunset Date: This poli cy w ill be revie wed for continua nce by 06/30/2025 . Approval for Release: RICK WANNE, Director Self-Sufficien cy Se rvices

title: 63-105 Expedited Services
content: County of San Diego, Health and H u m an Ser vices Agency (HHSA ) CalFresh Program Guide Number Page Expedited Services 63-10 5 1 of 3 Revision: 08/01/20 20 Back g r o und: Expedi t e d Services (ES) allo ws eligi ble customers to recei ve CalFresh be nefits while thei r case is bein g processed . W h en found e ligibl e to ES, benefits must be issued t o t h e customer wi t h in the 3-d ay ES timeframe . There are no ch anges d ue to State legisla t i on, this sectio n is b eing re -f o rmatt e d after sunset revie w. Purpose: This section de scribes the polici es for evaluating ES. Poli c y: ES must be screened a nd evaluated e ven when the ES section of the app lication is not comp leted. Appli cations that do not contain en ough informa t i on to determine ES elig ibility wil l be processed unde r regular C alFresh timeframes. The scre ening an d evalua t i on must be compl eted durin g t h e intake interview a nd anytime t he househ olds situa t i on chang es prior to g ranting the case. This inclu des customers bein g cert i f i ed or reappl ying after less than a one-mo nth break in aid . Cu st o mers must be offered app lication assistan ce and informed of their ri ght t o ES. Evalua t i ons must be comple t e d, and benefits i ssued w ithin the 3-day ES timeframe. Refer to CalFresh Expedited Services/Proce ssing Timeframes Desk Aid . 1. ES Criteria: When determin ing ES, actual monthly inco me an d l iquid resource s repo rt e d for the applica t i on month must b e used to d etermine ES elig ibility. T o be eligi ble to ES, a customer mu st meet o ne of the follow ing criteria: Customers with less than $150.00 in monthly gross income an d $1 00.00 or l ess in li quid resource s. (li quid resou rces are counted duri ng the ES evaluatio n) or Customers whose combined gross mo nthly inco me and liqui d resource s are less than t h e monthly rent or mortgage a nd utilities or Migran t or seasona l farm worker s who are destitute and have liqu id resou rces that are no t more than $10 0.00 After ES eligi bility criteri a is determine d to be met, the eli gibili t y d etermination must be completed as follow s: Budge t the income that can be reason ably anticipated over the ce rt i f i cation period to de t e rmine the bene f i t amo unt Evalua t e for el igibil ity to the State Utili t y Assistan ce S u bsidy (SUAS) Exempt resource s if the custome r is determined Mod ified Categori cal Eligib le (MCE) 2. ES Ineligi bility: Customers who are ine ligibl e to ES w ill not b e i ssued a de nial Notice of A ctio n (N O A). Customers dispu t i ng the ES i neligib ility may reque st an agency conference. Refer to Processing Guide 105-01 for steps on condu ct i ng an agen cy con f e rence. County of San Diego, Health and H u m an Ser vices Agency (HHSA ) CalFresh Program Guide Number Page Expedited Services 63-10 5 2 of 3 3. Verificatio ns Require d f or ES: The onl y verification re quired to i ssue ES is iden t i t y o f the customer. If the househo ld appli es through an Autho rized Rep resentative (AR), both the AR and customer must provide id entity verification. Refer to D esk Aid Verificatio n Requi rement Chart in Eligibil ity Essentials for a d etailed l isting of acceptab le forms of iden t i t y verifications. W h en pro cessing E S, att e mpt to ob t a in al l requ ired verificatio ns to a pprove ES and CalFresh at the sa me time. D o not delay t h e issua nce of ES whil e waitin g f o r t he mandatory verificatio ns t o be provided. 4. Processin g St a ndards: ES evalu ations must be co mpleted, and b enefits issued no later than the t h ird calen dar day follo wing the date t h e ap plication was recei ved. A weeken d (Saturd ay an d Sun day) will be considere d on e calen dar day. W h en t h e t h ird calenda r da y i s a no nworking da y an d benefits cannot be issued , the bene f i t s must be mad e availab le the last working da y prior to the third calend ar day. Recertifica t i on or re-appli cations after less t h an a one-month break in ai d must ha ve ES be nefits issued no l at e r than the t h ird cale ndar day followin g the da t e the appl ication i s filed o r by the house hold's normal issuance cycle in the new certification period , whiche ver is later. ES regula t i ons do not app ly if t he recertification is compl eted before the end of the certification p eriod. The ES time frame for cu st o mers eva luated and determine d el igible to ES du ring the i nitial interview wil l st a rt f rom t he date the coun t y be came aware of t h e househ olds ES el igibili t y. C ustomers applyi ng for bo t h CalWORKs and C alFresh (PACF) are el igible to ap ply for both ES and Immedi ate Need (IN) bene f i t s. O nl y one applica t i on and one i nterview are requ ired for both progra ms. The o nly excep t i on for co nducting a sep arate C alFresh i nterview is to prevent a del ay in the issuance of ES. Eval uate ES and IN i ndepend ently o f each other. E S evalu ation will not b e de layed while waitin g for the CalWORKs IN reque st to be pro cessed. 5. Customers with Postpon ed Verification s: Customers appro ved for ES who do not pro vide t he postpo ned ve rifications within 30-days from the date the appli cation was f i led w ill be discontinu ed. Customers may have t he ir ES eli gibili t y re- evalu ated if the postpo ned verificatio ns are recei ved during t h e second 30 -day perio d. Refer to 63- 109.6 f o r poli cy on p rocessing customer cause d dela ys. Customers w ho reap ply are not entitle d to ES again u nless the postpon ed verifications ha ve been provid ed. The N ot i ce of A p proval for CalFresh Benefits must b e sent in f o rming custome rs that no furthe r benefits w ill be issued until the postpon ed verifications are pro vided and eli gibili t y wi ll discontinu e i f they fail to provid e the p ost p oned verificatio ns. When the postponed verifications are provid ed, a re-eval uation mu st b e completed for future and ongo ing benefits. Postpon ed veri f i cations must be processed within five working days f ro m the date the verification s are rece ived, or the first day of the secon d ca lendar month, whiche ver i s la t e r. There is no limit to t he number of times a cust o mer may ap ply for ES. C ust o mers with postponed verificatio ns will have be nefits prorated and issu ed as follows: If the ap plication i s su bmitted Then i ss u e prora ted E S benefits for the on or before the 1 5 th of t h e month month of appl ication and the foll owing mon t h s benefits will be pen ding until a ny postponed veri f i cations are provi ded after the 15 th of the month appl ication month an d issue the followi ng months allo t me nt a t the same time County of San Diego, Health and H u m an Ser vices Agency (HHSA ) CalFresh Program Guide Number Page Expedited Services 63-10 5 3 of 3 Migran t farm w orker househ olds may postpon e out of stat e verifications on ce each farm season. The out of state verificatio n must be provide d within 60-d ays followin g the date the appl ication wa s fil ed. Migran t househo lds eli gible t o ES will receive t he prorated benefits for the applica t i on month and the follow ing month i f the only missin g verification is from an out of state source . W h en the out of state verificatio n is not received wi t hi n 60 days, benefits wil l be discontin ued. Procedure: CalFresh Pro cessing Guide 10 5-01 Refer ences: MPP 63-301 . 5 All Cou nty L ett e r 1 6-14 Sunset Date: This poli cy w ill be revie wed for continua nce by 08/31/2023 Approval for Release: RICK WANNE, Director Eligi bility Operation s

title: 63-107 Household Cooperation
content: County of San Diego, Health and H u m an Ser vices Agency (HHSA ) CalFresh Program Guide N u m b er Page Household C o operation 63-10 7 1 of 3 Revision Date 12/01/20 19 Back g r o und: House holds or the desi gnated authori zed represen t a t i ve must coo perate in the app lication proce ss and Qual ity C ontrol (QC) review pro cess. R efusal to coopera t e i n completing the ap plication pr ocess wil l r esult in the appli cation bein g denied. Hou seholds that refuse to coope rate with the QC review process w ill result in the hou sehold be ing sanctione d. Thi s re vision upd ates t he sect i on to t h e new format. There are no chan ges due to state legisla t i on. Purpose: This section de scribes the CalFresh reg ulations for hou seholds faili ng to cooperate wi t h the appl ication and the QC revie w process. Poli c y: 63-10 7.1 Hou s eho ld Cooperation to Dete rmine El igibil ity: In order to determin e eligib ility to t h e CalFresh prog ram, the h ousehol d or its au t h orized represe ntative must: Compl ete and sign the app lication form Be intervie wed; and Verify certain i nf o rmation on the app lication 63-10 7.2 Refusal to C o opera te: If t h e househo ld, includi ng exclude d househo ld members wh o are part of the Cal F re sh househo ld, refuses to coo perate in co mpleting the applicatio n process, the ap plication will be denied a t the t i me of refusal. In order to determin e t h at a h ousehol d has refused to coopera t e , the hou sehold must have be en able to coopera t e a nd clearly demo nstrated that t h e househo ld chose not to take the actions requi red to comple t e the a pplicatio n process. If t h e househo ld has merel y f ai led to coope rate, as opposed to refuse t o cooperate, the hou sehold wil l n ot be denied The house hold will al so be determined i neligib le when refusin g to coop erate in any subsequ ent review of elig ibility, includ ing reviews gen erated by reported change s, recertificatio ns, or as part of a QC review. Note: Refusal t o di sclose a Social S e curity Number (SSN) is an exce ption to the denia l of the en t i re house hold. When an ind ividual req uired to provid e his/her SSN has refused to compl y, the el igibil ity of the other house hold membe rs w ill not be affected. If a n oncitizen refuse s to pro vide immigratio n documentatio n or t h e sponsors informa t i on (unless they meet an excep t i on to sponsorshi p provisions foun d in 63-157.3), the non citizen will be considered a n exclud ed member of the CalFresh h ousehol d and his/her inco me, re sources and ded uctible expe nses wil l b e counted accord ing to Sections 63-24 4 and 63-206 . 63-10 7.3 Refusal to C o opera te w ith a QC review: The Q u ality an d Elig ibility Support Departments (Q ESD ) and QC staff are respo nsible for cond ucting review s as part of the Countys Performa nce Reportin g Syst e m. For QC revie ws, a stat i st i cal sample County of San Diego, Health and H u m an Ser vices Agency (HHSA ) CalFresh Program Guide N u m b er Page Household C o operation 63-10 7 2 of 3 of house holds wil l be selected from active cases and den ied, suspend ed, or terminated Ca lFresh cases. The QC review pe riod extends from October 1 st to September 30 th of t h e next year. A h ousehold can be selected f o r a St a t e or F e deral review of Cal F r esh be nefits autho rized for a specific sampl e mon t h . Coo peration is mandatory for b oth types of reviews. If a househo ld ref u ses to coope rate, it is subje ct t o St a t e or Federal sanctions an d it is ine ligibl e to receive CalFresh. When a house hold member refuses to coopera t e in a QC review, t h e entire hou sehold must be discon t i nued from the CalFresh program at the end of the month in which a timely and ad equate notice ca n be provid ed. The QESD Elig ibility Sup port staff a re responsi ble for imposi ng the QC sanctio n on the Cal Fresh house hold, as specifie d in How To #335. Failure to coope rate with the QC review is a C ounty initia t e d action. There f o re, the sanctio ned house hold shou ld be discontin ued mid-pe riod with timely notice . Re f e r to 63 -285.1. Sanction P e rio ds Once deni ed or discontin ued for refusal to coopera t e w ith t h e Q C re view, the househ old may reappl y but wil l n ot b e eligib le until the hou sehold coop erates with the QC review du ring the review pe riod. I f the house hold doe s no t coo perate durin g t he review perio d, the h ousehol d will be ine ligibl e t o particip ate f o r a sp ecified perio d, d ependi ng on the review type (State or Federa l). State The house hold is not eli gible to reapp ly until at least 125 days after the end o f the an nual review perio d in which the refusa l t o co operate with a State QC reviewe r occurred. Federal The house hold is not eli gible to reapp ly until 9 months after the end of the annu al review pe riod in which the r ef u sal to cooperate wi t h a Fed eral QC reviewe r o ccurred. Refer to 63-11 03 Definitio ns and Examples for examp les of S tate an d F e deral sanctio ns. Note: An applica nts house hold that has been sanctione d for not coo perating with QC wi ll be required to pro vide ve rification of all eligib ility req uirements, i ncludin g items t ha t would normal ly be verified only i f que st i onable , as spe cified in 63-11 7. 63-10 7.4 Coo per atin g with QESD: The QESD Eligib ility Support staff are responsi ble for ending the QC san ct i on on the CalFresh house hold as follo ws: QC Sanctions wi ll be removed a nd the CalFresh case w ill be re-ope ned when : the sanction ed househ old coopera t e s a nd completes the revie w during the QC review period, and the ho usehold coo perates durin g t he month of t he discontinua nce (sanction has no t taken effect) QC Sanctions wi ll be removed b ut the C alFresh house hold must re-appl y f or C alFresh when: the sanction ed househ old coopera t e s a nd completes the revie w during the QESD review perio d, b ut the y co operate after the month of discontin uance (sanctio n is already in effect) County of San Diego, Health and H u m an Ser vices Agency (HHSA ) CalFresh Program Guide N u m b er Page Household C o operation 63-10 7 3 of 3 63-10 7.5 F a i lure to Cooperate with QESD: The QESD Eligib ility Support staff are responsi ble for assisting the QC review er in locating house holds that fail to coope rate during the QESD review p eriod, by sendin g t h e CF 3 87 Request for Information (RFI) to the last known ad dress, as outlined in 6 3-152.8. 63-10 7.6 Non -C o opera ti ng Household Mem b e r: Non-Cooperating H o usehold Member If a non-co operating househol d member ref u ses to coope rate in a Q C review, the e ntire house hold must be discontin ued from t h e CalFresh progra m at the end of the month in which a time ly a nd adeq uate notice can be pro vided. Non-Cooperating H o usehold Member leaves the Household Durin g the Sanction Pe rio d If t he non-coope rating househ old member(s) le aves the househ old (househ old #1) duri ng the sanction p eriod, the sanction wi ll follow the no n-cooperatin g househo ld member(s). If the re maining house hold membe rs from the ori ginal hou sehold we re not considere d non-coope rating members, they wil l b e eligib le to reapply for CalFresh . Non-Cooperating H o usehold Member leaves the Household and joins ano ther C alF r esh Household If t he non-coope rating househ old member (from hou sehold #1) j oins another Ca lFresh househ old (house hold #2), hou sehold #2 be comes ineli gible until t he sanction ends or the non -cooperatin g house hold membe r co mplies with the QC revie w during the QC review period and C alFresh house hold sanctio n is lifted. Refer to 63-11 03 Definitio n and Examples for examp les. Procedure: Required Actions EO st a f f are to refer the Cal F r esh househo ld to t h e Q C re viewer for coope ration in the QC review. Other Program Impacts None Refer ences: MPP 63-505 ; ACL 1 1-72; ACL 11-72E; How To #3 35 Sunset Date: This poli cy w ill be revie wed for continua nce on or by 11/30/202 2 Approval for Release: RICK WANNE, Director Eligi bility Operation s

Elderly Household Member An eld erly CalFresh househo ld member i s a member of a h ousehol d who i s 60 years of age or older. ICT INTER-COUNTY TRANSFER A transfer of re sponsibi lity for determina t i on of eli gibili t y and provisi on of social servi ces (includi ng CalFresh) from one cou nty to an other. SENDING COUNTY The county from which the h ousehol d has moved. RECEIVING COUNTY The county to which the h ousehol d has moved. TRANSFER PERIOD The perio d of time i n which the send ing county remain s re sponsibl e f or paymen t of ben efits. 30-DA Y T R ANSFER PERIO D The 30-da y tran sf e r p eriod begi ns t h e date the sending co unty informs the recei ving county of the transfer, either vi a the postmarked da t e i f maile d or the date of the electronic transfer of t he no t i f i cation of the ICT. When the 30 t h day falls on a Saturday, S u nday, or lega l hol iday, the first busine ss d ay f o llowin g the weeken d or holida y is considere d t o be the last day of the 30-da y tran sf e r p eriod. EXPIRATION O F THE TRANSFER PERIOD The e xpiration of the transfer period occurs at t he end of the mon t h follow ing the 30-day transfer period after the sending coun t y eithe r mai ls or electron ically transfers the notifica t i on of t he I C T to the receivi ng county or t h e en d of the month in which benefits are discontinu ed f or other re asons, which ever is earl ier. By mutual agreemen t of t h e countie s invol ved, the transfer of responsi bility ma y occur at an earli er date. Migrant F a rm Worker Season A migran t farm sea son is defined as having a cl ear begin ning poi nt a nd endi ng poin t be t w een whi ch migrant farm wo rkers travel. When they are not migr at i ng to work they are residi ng at one location w hich they regard as ho me. In thi s case, the season would be the period during which t h e migrants are travel ing to work. If a migrant farm worker travel s constantly w ith no break pe riod, the season w ill be consi dered the calen dar year. SAR CONVERSION FACTOR A figure use d t o convert income p aid on a w eekly or bi-w eekly basis to a monthly ave raged figure . Weekl y a mounts are multipli ed by 4.33 and bi-we ekly amounts by 2.167 . COUNTY INITIATED MI D -PERIO D A CTI ONS The change s in elig ibility status based on case information that the worker i s req uired to act upon mid- period in wh ich timely and ade quate notice can b e provi ded, even if the action results in a de crease i n bene f i t s, su ch as san ct i ons, financia l pena lties, approva l of ben efits in anothe r househ old, the en d of an inter-county transfer, or cost-of-living chang es. EXTENDED FILING D ATE The final date by which the house hold must submit a comp lete Semi- Annua l Report (SAR 7) in cluding a ll require d verification w ithout terminatio n of eligib ility. In a SAR system, this is the first workin g da y of the next paymen t pe riod. FLUCTUATING I N COME Income is consid ered to be fluctuatin g when the amo unt varies signi f i cantly for ea ch month of t he certification period. This include s when t h e househ old has i ncome for one or more months of the certification perio d and zero i ncome for the rema ining months of the certification p eriod due to inco me st a rt i ng or stopping . INCOME REPORTING T H RESHOLD (I R T ) The IRT is the level of income that triggers the requiremen t of a SAR CalFresh hou sehold who has b een ce rt i f i ed w ith gross income at or belo w 130% of the FPL to report a change du ring the certification pe riod. Note: House holds certified between 131% and 200% of t h e FPL will not be requi red to make an y reports of income durin g the S AR paymen t period . These hou seholds wi ll not have a CalFresh I R T . Refer to: Processing Gui de 63-271-0 1 Refer to 63-11 01.6 for CalFresh IRT. MID-PERIOD CHAN G ES Any chan ge reported du ring the certification period that is outsid e the SAR 7 report or the re certification pro cess. There are t w o types of mid- perio d reports: Mandatory Mid-Period R ep ort s: Under SAR, recipie nts a re manda t e d to report spe cified chan ges within 10 cale ndar days of the date the change be comes known t o t h e househ old. The manda t o ry re porting requi rements for CalFresh are: o The househ olds income goes over the CalFresh IRT or when o Work hours for able-bod ied adults without depe ndents (ABAWD) d rop be low 20 ho urs ave raged monthly outside of the hou sehold s ini t i al ce rt i f i cation/ rece rt i f i cation and SAR 7 reportin g month. Volun ta ry Mid -Per i od Reports: Rep orts made by the house hold durin g t he ce rt i f i cation period that are not manda t o ry. PROSPECTIVE BUDG Budge t i ng methodolo gy t ha t use s rea sonably antici pated income for the determin ation of benefits for a househ old. REASONAB L Y A NTI C I PA T ED INC O ME AN D E XPEN SES Income a nd expe nses that have been or will be bud geted for the upcomi ng certification peri od when: The income has bee n or will be ap proved or authori zed as of a date within the upcoming certification peri od, or the househol d is otherwi se reasonabl y certai n t h at the in come will be recei ved within the period; and The amoun t of inco me is known. content: County of San Diego, Health and H u m an Ser vices Agency (HHSA ) CalFresh Program Guide Number Page Authorized Representatives 63-11 3 1 of 2 Revision Date: 03/01/20 23 Back g r o und: Customers may choose an ad ult non-ho usehold member as an Authori zed Rep resentative (AR ) to act on their beh alf. Multipl e AR s may be chosen to fulfill di st i nct ro les and responsi bilities. For example , the AR desig nated to apply for the HH may be different from the AR chose n to use the EBT card . The desig nation of t h e AR wi ll remain in effect for the duration of the ce rt i f i cation period, unless the HH chooses to ch ange the A R . An AR must be an ind ividual and canno t be an organiza t i on or agen cy. Customers seekin g assistan ce from Commun ity-Based O r ganization s (CBO), agencie s, reside ntial f a cilities or other similar institutions must de signate an in dividua l emplo yee of t h at facility as the AR. The AR must ha ve sufficient knowl edge of the customers circumstan ces to comple t e t h e appli cation and / o r recertification process. Customers must be informe d that t h e HH will be responsi ble for any overissuan ce (OI) that results from incorrect informa t i on given by the AR. An AR may rep resent more than one HH . The follow ing table provi des guida nce on AR design ations for special H H situations: HH Situation AR Des i gnation Customer ha s a S o cial Security Repre sentative Payee The representative payee can act as AR, but the HH must design ate t h e representative pa yee as the AR. AR provid es documents such as Power of Attorney, conserva t o rship, or guard ianship The docu ments may be use d to authorize a t h ird party to act a s AR. Once it has been determi ned that the third party has the authority to act on behalf of the customer, the t h ird party is no t requ ired to b e desig nated as an AR. Customer resi des at a Drug/Alcoho l Treatment and Re habili t a t i on Centers The resi dent must use a n AR who is emplo yed and desig nated by the D/ATC to ap ply, ob t a in, an d use County of San Diego, Health and H u m an Ser vices Agency (HHSA ) CalFresh Program Guide Number Page Authorized Representatives 63-11 3 2 of 2 (D/ATC) bene f i t s. The AR must be an employe e of t he D/AT C and can not b e an organi zation or institution . Customer resi des at a Group Living Arrange ment (G L A) The resid ent has the op t i on to apply on their own beha lf, throu gh an AR of their choice or an A R emplo yed a nd de signated by t h e GLA. I f the re sident uses an AR designa t ed by the GLA, t he AR must be an e mployee o f t he GLA and can not be an organ ization or institutio n. Note: Refer to 63-123 Re sidents of Drug/Alco hol Treatment an d Rehabi litation Ce nters (D/ATC) and Group Livi ng Arrangeme nts (GLA) for gui dance on D/ATC and GLA requ irements. 2. Verification o f AR: The identity o f both t he AR and t he customer must be verified and image d at intake, recertifica t i on and whe never a new AR is ap pointed. D/ATC and GLA must provi de a w ritt e n stateme nt on the centers l et terh ead desig nating the AR and pro vide the identity of the AR. 3. Restrictions on A R Designatio ns: The follow ing indi viduals cann ot b e designa t e d as A R s: Employe es invol ved in t he eligi bility de t e rmination process or retailers w ho are authorized t o accept Ca lFresh bene f i t s. If no one else can a ct a s AR, a request must be sent to the CalFresh Program Man ager for approva l of the i ndividua l t o b e designa t e d as A R . Individ uals disqu alified for an Intention al Program Viol ation (IPV) cannot act as an AR during the disqu alification pe riods. I f no one el se can act as AR, a reque st must be sent to t h e CalFresh Program Man ager for approva l of the i ndividua l t o b e designa t e d as A R . Employe es of ho meless meal service pro viders, such as soup kitchens or shelters, that are authori zed to accept CalFresh ben efits. An AR t ha t has been disqual ified for kno wingly p roviding f a lse informatio n about H H circumstance s or impr oper use of EBT benefits ca nnot act as an AR du ring the disqual ification perio d. 4. Emergency AR De signation : HH s can design ate an emerg ency AR to obtain benefits and p urchase food for a specific month. The desig nation must be made usin g t he C alFresh AR design ation form or a w ritt en stateme nt sig ned by the customer and AR . title: 63-115 Interview Requirements
content: County of San Diego, Health and H u m an Ser vices Agency (HHSA ) CalFresh Program Guide Number Page Interview Requirements 63-11 5 1 of 2 Revision: 08/01/20 20 Back g r o und: Customers ap plying or rea pplying for Cal F r esh must be interviewe d prior to initial ce rt i f i cation and recertificatio n. There are no changes due to State legisl ation, this section is being re-formatted aft e r sunset revie w. Purpose: This section de scribes the polici es for t he interview proce ss. Poli c y: An interview must be completed at initial certification and at least once every 12 months the reafter. An i nt e rview must be comple t e d by ph one unl ess the custome r is una ble to d o so or request otherwi se. The i nterview must be completed with the head of hou sehold, t he ir spou se, a d esignated Authorize d Repre sentative (AR ) or ano t h er respon sible househol d member. Customers can ask any person they choo se to attend the interview . Confiden t i ality guid elines must be pre served wh en intervie wing the customer. Note: Elderly Simplified Appl ication Project (ESAP) cases will require an interview at in itial certification . The rece rt i f i cation interview requiremen t s for ESAP cases are ou t l ined in CFPG 63-360 . 1. Interview R equiremen t s: A review of the app lication to determi ne if t he information is consi st e nt w ith what has been rep orted or is known to the cou nty mu st be co mpleted to assist staff w ith t he interview. During t he interview staff must explore , cla rify, an d resolve any uncl ear or inconsi st e nt i nf o rmation with the customer. Customers must also be informed of the Righ t s & Resp onsibil ities, and reporting re quiremen t s, inclu ding how to comp lete the SAR 7. W h en there are pend ing verificatio ns, staff must explain w hy the verificatio ns are neede d and offer assistance in obtai ning them. Provide the customer with a printed copy of the Statement of Facts for their records. Case Commen t s must be en t e red detaili ng all the informatio n obtained an d shared durin g t h e interview. 2. Face-to-Face or Home Vi sit Intervi ews: Customers t ha t do not have a phone, are unable to co me into the office d ue to a hardsh ip or prefer to not to complete the intervie w by p hone may be schedu led for a face -t o -f a ce o r ho me visit interview. The reason for face-to-face or ho me visit interview must be do cumented in case co mments. 3. Lang uage Nee ds: Non-En glish-spe aking customers must be informed of t he ir ri ght to have an i nterpreter, an d wh en avail able, must re ceive the f o rms in the customers preferre d l anguage . The Lang uage Needs form is requi red for all cases, regard less of t he cust o mers langu age. Refer to the Civil Ri ghts Eligibi lity Policy and Proce dures Guide for informatio n on pro viding services to n on-Engli sh speakin g customers and cu st o mers with disabi lities. 4. Missed Intervie w: When a cust o mer mi sses their schedu led interview, a N otice o f Missed Interview (NOMI) must be sent. T h e N O MI informs t h e cu st o mer that they need to re schedule the interview . When the customer does not resche dule the interview , or resche dules and fails to attend subsequen t interviews, t h e County of San Diego, Health and H u m an Ser vices Agency (HHSA ) CalFresh Program Guide Number Page Interview Requirements 63-11 5 2 of 2 appl ication w ill be denie d on the 30 th day. T he customer w ill be mailed the Notice o f Action (NOA) Notice of Deni al of Pendin g Status on or aft e r t h e 30 th day follow ing the date of appl ication. Customers who resch edule an d f ai l t o attend subsequ ent intervie ws wil l not be ma iled additiona l NOMIs. When a customer contacts the county and the county fails to re schedule t h e initial interview within 3 0 days of the da t e the app lication was file d, it wil l be considere d county ca used de lay. Refer t o 63-109 for polici es regardin g t i me limits and dela ys in applica t i on processin g. Other Program Impacts: None Refer ences: ACL 09-6 2 MPP 63-300 . 4 Sunset Date: This poli cy w ill be revie wed for continua nce by 08/31/2023 Approval for Release: RICK WANNE, Director Eligi bility Operation s

title: 63-117 Verification and Documentation
content: County of Sa n Diego, Health and Human S e rvices Agency (HH SA) CalFresh Program Guide Number Page Verification and D o c u m entatio n 63-11 7 1 of 5 Revision Date: 09/01/20 21 Back g r o und: Verificatio n is t h e use of t h ird-party informatio n or documentation to estab lish the accuracy of statements on the app lication. Purpose: This section de t a ils mandatory and o ptional verifica t i ons for CalFresh and the di f fere nt w ays t o ve rify. Poli c y: The hou sehold ha s primary respon sibility for provid ing requi red verification and to resolve an y questio nable i nf o rmation. Before reque st i ng additio nal verificatio ns from t h e househo ld, the Human Services Special ist (HSS) i s to attempt verification via el ectronic me ans such as Inco me Elig ibility Verificatio n System (IEVS), Pa yment Veri f i cation System (PVS), Medi-C al Eligibi lity D ata System (MEDS) and the W o rk Numb er (WN). If unab le t o verify or information is questiona ble, send a req uest for information to the househo ld. Do not limit verification to any singl e type of docume nt. Assist customers in o btaining requi red veri f i cations as nee ded. Use a colla t e ral con t a ct or h ome vi sit if necessa ry. House holds or the Authorized R epresentative may provi de verification in perso n, throu gh the mail, onli ne, fax, or ema il. Any reason able verification provid ed by the househo ld w ill be a ccepted and used t o verify the statements gi ven on the applica t i on. Issue recei pts to CalFresh applica nts and recipi ents whe n they submit verifications in-perso n at t he office. When documents are su bmitted other than in p erson, a receipt is not requi red. 1. Questiona ble Information: For information to be consi dered questio nable, the information on the ap plication mu st be incon sistent with statements made by the appl icant, with other i nformation on t he applica t i on or previo us applica t i ons, or with information rece ived by the County. When determini ng i f informatio n is question able, base t he deci sion on the hou sehold's indivi dual circumstance s. For exa mple, a report of expen ses excee ding the ho usehold s inco me pri or to dedu ct i ons may be grou nds to request verifica t i on or additio nal verificatio n. A h ousehol d reporting no income whil e still managin g their f i nancial aff a irs coul d justify the need f o r an additiona l verificatio n reque st . These circumstances, how ever, will not be grounds for an immed iate den ial or discontinua nce. Instead, expl ore with the househo ld how t h ey are man aging the ir finances, w hether the ho usehold receive s exclud ed in come or has re sources, and how long the ho usehold has managed under these circumstance s. When verificatio n is require d to resolve questiona ble i nformation, the HSS must docume nt i n case comments: Why t he informa t i on i s consi dered questiona ble, o r at a min imum i ndicate where in the case the incon sistency exists What documen t a t i on was used to resolve t he questionab le information (i f it is resolve d) and if appl icable, the reason wh y an altern ate source of ve rification such as a col lateral contact o r home visit was nee ded County of Sa n Diego, Health and Human S e rvices Agency (HH SA) CalFresh Program Guide Number Page Verification and D o c u m entatio n 63-11 7 2 of 5 2. Manda t o ry Ve rifications: Verificatio n must b e obtained i n t he se categories if it is appli cable to the house hold. Gross Non-Exempt Income: Determine the amount to be used for certification purpo ses ba sed o n the best avail able information. Househ olds mu st provide information abou t income received durin g the 30 days prior t o submission of their app lication o r recertification. For re certifications, staff must veri f y a cha nge i n inco me if o ne of t he follow ing ci rcumstances o ccur: the so urce ha s chang ed, the amoun t has changed by more t h an $5 0, or if the informatio n is incompl ete, inaccu rate, i nconsistent, or outdated (See 6 3-220 and 63 -304). Non-C itizen Eli gibili t y: Verify the i mmigration stat u s of those non-citizen s who are applying for CalFresh bene f i t s. See Proce ssing Guid e 117-0 2 for add itional information regardin g non-ci t i zen elig ibility. Identity: See 63 -152 for information regard ing identity. See the Verification Req uirements Chart for additio nal informatio n. Social Se curity Numbers (SSN): Househ olds must provide the SSN of each me mber or provide verificatio n of a pplicatio n f or an S SN prior to certification. I f ind ividual s ha ve more than one SSN, all nu mbers are requi red. Se e 63-161 for addi t i onal SSN informa t i on. Resid ency: Verifica t i on of resid ency in t h e C ounty of San Di ego will be accompl ished to t h e extent possibl e usi ng the verification of other information such as, identity or as a la st resort the customers statement on the Statement of Facts (SOF ). S e e 63-152 for addition al residency informatio n. 3. Manda t o ry Ve rifications That Do Not Impact Eligib ility: Verificatio ns o btained in these categori es do no t imp act eli gibili t y, howe ver, they do impa ct ben efit allo t me nt amoun t . Failu re to provide the veri f i cation is not a ba sis for denying or discontinui ng a case if t h e p erson is otherwise elig ible. If verification is not provide d, the expe nse, e xemption, or e xclusion is not allo wed. Medica l Expenses: Prior to allow ing the Excess Medical Deduction or Stand ard Medical Dedu ct i on (SMD), verify t h e amount of medical exp enses that are dedu ct i ble as listed in 63 -232. Disab ility: R eceipt of any of the benefits listed b elow qua lifies as verification o f di sability:. o Social Se curity Disabil ity B e nefits o Disab ility Retiremen t Ben efits o Disab ility Related Med i-Cal Assistance - Verify through coun t y record s tha t the ind ividual receive s disabil ity based Medi-C al as determin ed by the State Program D isability Determin ation Service Di vision (DDSD ). o Veteran Re lated Disabi lities o Rail road Retireme nt Student Exemp t i on: A customers st a t e ment is sufficient evi dence that a student meets on e of the exemptio ns un less the informa t i on pro vided is q uestionabl e or when a students claim of ph ysical or mental un f i t n ess is not evident. County of Sa n Diego, Health and Human S e rvices Agency (HH SA) CalFresh Program Guide Number Page Verification and D o c u m entatio n 63-11 7 3 of 5 Lega lly Obli gated Child Support and Actua l Paymen t s: Verify child support or obtai n payme nt informatio n from the Local Chil d Supp ort Agency (LCSA) au t o mated data files i f the da t a is avail able. Once the verifica t i on is received, the circumstances need not be verified again unless there is a chan ge in the lega l obliga t i on or an increase i n t h e amount of the payment. See 63-224 for additio nal child su pport payments exclusi on information. 4. Optional Ve rifications: Below is a l ist of items that fall under optiona l veri f i cat i ons. Option al ver ifications are n on-manda t ed and must only be reque st e d i f releva nt in f o rmation is questionab le. Req uest op t i onal verificatio ns for the purpo ses of ma ximizing be nefits, ho wever they must be marked as op t i onal on the requ est. Failure t o pro vide verificatio n of op t i onal verifica t i ons must not result in a denia l or discontinu ance or cause a de lay in the determin ation of eligib ility. Depe ndent Care Costs: De pendent care costs can be verified through an affida vit on the appl ication, the Depe ndent Care Cost Affidavit or other affida vit. Purpose: This section de t a ils mandatory and o ptional verifica t i ons for CalFresh and the di f fere nt w ays t o ve rify. Poli c y: The hou sehold ha s primary respon sibility for provid ing requi red verification and to resolve an y questio nable i nf o rmation. Before reque st i ng additio nal verificatio ns from t h e househo ld, the Human Services Special ist (HSS) i s to attempt verification via el ectronic me ans such as Inco me Elig ibility Verificatio n System (IEVS), Pa yment Veri f i cation System (PVS), Medi-C al Eligibi lity D ata System (MEDS) and the W o rk Numb er (WN). If unab le t o verify or information is questiona ble, send a req uest for information to the househo ld. Do not limit verification to any singl e type of docume nt. Assist customers in o btaining requi red veri f i cations as nee ded. Use a colla t e ral con t a ct or h ome vi sit if necessa ry. House holds or the Authorized R epresentative may provi de verification in perso n, throu gh the mail, onli ne, fax, or ema il. Any reason able verification provid ed by the househo ld w ill be a ccepted and used t o verify the statements gi ven on the applica t i on. Issue recei pts to CalFresh applica nts and recipi ents whe n they submit verifications in-perso n at t he office. When documents are su bmitted other than in p erson, a receipt is not requi red. 1. content: County of Sa n Diego, Health and Human S e rvices Agency (HH SA) CalFresh Program Guide Number Page Categorical Eligi bility 63-12 0 1 of 5 Revision Date 06/01/20 19 Back g r o und: House hold in wh ich al l eli gible members receive P u blic A ssi st a nce (PA) benefits sha ll be consid ered categori cally eli gible ( CE) for CalFresh benefits beca use of their status as PA recipie nts. T h is section is be ing revise d to reflect the ch ange in regulatio n as a re sult of the reversa l of the SSI/SSP cash-ou t poli cy. Effective Jun e 1, 2019, i ndividu als rece iving SSI /SSP are e ligibl e for CalFresh, p rovided they meet all other el igibil ity req uirements. Househ olds in which al l members receive or are au t h orized to receive SSI/ SSP benefits are categorica lly elig ible for CalFresh. Fede ral Nutritio n Services (F N S) iden t i f i es t h ree types of Categorica l E l igibil ity (CE): Tradition al Cate g orica l Eligib ility (CE) Tradition al C E refers to the manda t o ry poli cy that makes househol ds el igible for CalFresh bene f i t s because the ho usehold receive s cash benefits such as T e mporary Assi st an ce for N eedy Famili es (T AN F ), CalWORKs in C alifornia, or Genera l Relief (GR). Modifi e d Cate g orica l Eligib ility (MCE) or Broad-Base d Ca tego r i c al Eligibi lity (BBC E) MCE/BBCE refers t o t h e policy t h at makes most hou seholds cat e goricall y eligib le for Cal F re sh becau se t h ey receive a non -cash TANF/ MOE-funde d benefit or service, such as PUB 275 i n Cali f o rnia. MCE i s only intende d to exempt reso urces for househ olds who me et all other condi t i ons of eligib ility. Narr o w Cate g orica l Eligib ility This refers t o the pol icy t ha t makes a smalle r nu mber of ho usehold s el igible throug h the rece ipt o f a TANF/MOE-f un ded service such a s ch ildcare or coun seling. Note: Non-Assi st a nce CalFresh (NAC F ) do es not include case s w ithin this category. Purpose: This section de scribes the regula t i ons and elig ibility requ irements for CE. Poli c y: 63-12 0.1 Categorical El igibil ity (C E): A h ousehold wil l be consid ered (trad itional) Categori cal Eli gible (CE) w hen AL L Cal Fresh el igible members receive or are au t h orized to receive ca sh aid t h rough a Public Assistance (PA) pro gram funded in full or in part with federal mone y un der T i t l e IV-A or with state mo ney counted for mainten ance of effort (MOE) purp oses under Title IV-A. The follow ing cash aid customers are conside red CE: CalWORKs recipi ents (Immediate Need payments are also considere d a P A benefit) State f un ded CalWORKs i n which ho usehold members have reached their fed eral TANF time limi t . This inclu des househ olds whose: Cash ove rpayment adju st me nt resu lts in the issuance of zero PA ben efits GR benefits have be en suspend ed or recouped , or those w ho are entitled to GR bene f i t s but are not paid su ch benefits because the gran t is bel ow the minimum payab le under the GR progra m PA be nefits have been su spended, or those who are entitled to PA ben efits but are not pa id such ben efits b ecause the grant is less than $ 10.00 MPP 63-102 (p)(12)(a) If a househo ld mem ber lo ses both CalWORKs and C alFresh eligibi lity, the remainin g house hold memb ers CE status is no t a f fected . CE only rel ates t o fed eral SNAP eligi bility. If the h ousehol d: Contai ns only CalFresh eligi ble members that are PA recipien t s Meets the defini t i on of a house hold as specified in 63-101 Include s all persons who purchase an d pre pare food together in one CalFresh househol d regard less of whethe r they are separate units for PA purpose s Has not been disqua lified or d oes no t in clude perso ns who have been disqual ified IPV or fleein g felons ACIN I-58-08. 63-12 0.4 Categorically El igible Gen e ral Relief (G R ) H o use h olds: Any hou sehold i n which a ll CalFresh eligib le members rece ive or are authorized to re ceive GR bene f i t s are co nsidered el igible for Ca lFresh because of their status as GR recipi ents. The elig ibility factors that are acceptab le for CalFresh eli gibili t y wi t h out verification are: Gross and net inco me limits Resou rces Sponso red noncitize n information Resid ency A househ old is not consid ered CE when: The ho usehold refuses to coop erate in pro viding information that i s necessary for ma king an elig ibility determi nation or for comple t i ng any subsequ ent eligib ility review The house hold is disqua lified becau se t he h ead of househol d f ai ls t o com ply with a work requi rement A househ old who is in eligib le under the striker provi sions A househ old knowin gly t ra nsferred resources for the purpose of qua lifying or attempting to qual ify for assi st a nce The follow ing indi viduals are no t i ncluded as a memb er of a n otherwise CE hou sehold: Disqu alified for an Intentio nal Program Viol ation Not the head of ho usehold and disq ualified for failure to comply with t he wo rk requ irements as specifie d in 63-900 Disqu alified for faili ng to provide the Socia l Security Number Inelig ible non citizen Inelig ible studen t Institutional ized in a non exempt facility as specified i n 63-123 Note : Advise all GR app licant house holds of the potential e ligibi lity f o r C alFresh bene f i t s and p rovide them with the Cal F r esh applica t i on form CF 2 85 or SAWS 2 Plu s. Recei pt of the PUB 275 does no t quali f y a hou sehold f o r MCE. The MCE evalu ation must be docume nted for Q u ality Control pu rposes. Expedi t e d Services Refer to 63-10 5 MCE House holds House holds with gro ss i ncome at or below 2 00% of FPL House holds that do not incl ude any of the followi ng indivi duals: o A member who has been disq ualified for an IPV o A head of hou sehold who has failed to comply w ith work requireme nts Procedure: Refer to CalFresh P r oces sing Guid e #120-01 Deter min ing the All otm en t for an MCE Household: MCE house holds consi st i ng of: One or two me mbers are entitle d to at least the minimum a llotment even if their n et income excee ds the Maximum N et Income limit. Three or more member s will receive an all otment accordin g to the h ousehol d size as determined by the CalFresh Al lotment Table. If the minimum allo t me nt determi ned by the CalFresh Allotmen t Table is zero, de ny the appl ication or discontin ue t he case for exceed ing the net i ncome limit. See the How to Use the CalFresh A l lotment Table Desk Aid .  If the a llotment amoun t is less than $ 10 or is $0 in the month of appl ication due to pror at i on, but the house hold is eli gible to receive ongoing b enefits, approve the app lication wi t ho ut issuin g benefits for the appli cation month. title: 63-152 Identity and Residency
content: County of San Diego, Health and H u m an Ser vices Agency (HHSA ) CalFresh Program Guide Number Page Identity a n d Res i dency 63-15 2 1 of 2 Revision Date: 11/01/20 20 Back g r o und Identity and resid ency must be verified as pa rt of the app lication proce ss f or C alFresh. Purpose: This section describes the policies for identity a nd resi dency verification. There are no chan ges d ue to State legisla t i on, t h is section is being u pdated after sunset review . Poli c y: The identity and residency of the person appl ying f o r Cal F re sh must be verified. W h en a n Autho rized Repre sentative (A/ R ) app lies on be half o f a househo ld, the identity of bo t h the A/R and hea d of house hold must be veri f i ed. Customers who do not have an y f orm o f i dentification (ID) may veri f y their identity through a collateral contact. A collatera l con t a ct is a verba l con f i rmation of a customers iden t i t y by a pe rson outside of the house hold. content: County of San Diego, Health and H u m an Ser vices Agency (HHSA ) CalFresh Program Guide N u m b er Page Food Distribution Program o n Indi an Res ervation 63-16 6 1 of 1 Revision Date 01/24/20 20 Back g r o und: Customers l iving on India n Reservation s or triba l members livi ng off the re servation may choose to receive f oo d f ro m the Foo d Distribution Prog ram instead of receivi ng CalFresh. Food recei ved from the Food Di st ri bution Program is cal led commodi t i es. C ustomers cannot receive CalFresh and commodi t i es in the same month. Customers can t ran sf e r f rom on e program to the other, with timely notice. This revisi on updates the section to the ne w f o rmat. There a re no change s du e t o state legi slation. Purpose: This section de scribes the regula t i ons about CalFresh and commoditie s. Poli c y: 63-16 6.1 Dual Pa rticip a ti on : Dual participation me ans customers are getting bo t h C alFresh and commod ities in the same month. Durin g t h e intake process, it is importan t to ask customers if they are recei ving commodi t i es. Aski ng this questio n will hel p t o a void dual p articipation an d any overissua nce (OI ) for the customer. Procedure: 63-16 6.2 CalFresh Program Specialist Responsib ilities: In San Dieg o County, the Food Distribu t i on Program is run by Southe rn Californi a T ri bal Chairma ns Associatio n (SDCTA). Ea ch month SCTCA notifies the CalFresh P r ogram Special ist o f custome rs who are receiving food comm odities. The CalFresh Prog ram Speciali st is resp onsible for determi ning if these customers are rece iving CalFresh benefits. Customers who rece ived CalFresh an d commodi t i es in the same month wi ll have an OI. The C alFresh Program Spe cialist and SDCTA wil l determin e if the co unty or S D CTA is responsibl e f o r the OI. 63-16 6.3 O v erissuances: Recei ving CalFresh a nd commodities i n t he same month will resu lt in an OI. Instructions wi ll be sent to the Family Resou rce Center (FRC) to set up the OI as an Ina dvertent Househo ld Error (IHE). Other Program Impacts None Refer ences: MPP 63-402 . 7 CFR 253.1 Sunset Date: This poli cy w ill be revie wed for continua nce on or by 01/31/202 3 Approval for Release: RICK WANNE, Director Eligi bility Operation s

Types of Self-Employme nt: Self-empl oyment income sha ll includ e but is not limited to: Type Desc rip tion Indepe ndent Contractor An indivi dual who provide s goo ds or service s to another entity under a specific contract or agreement. The i ndepen dent contractor is n ot subject to the control of the entity they are p erforming the service s f o r. There is no emplo yee/employe r re lationshi p. Gig-Econo my Contractor An i ndepend ent contractor pa id on a per task basis for a job tha t is usual ly coordi nated in conjunctio n wi t h an onl ine or ap plication -based tool provided by a third party. Exampl es inclu de, but are not limi t e d to, UBER, Lyft, Postmates, and Do orDash. Individ uals workin g in the gig-eco nomy oft e n receive payme nt vi a direct depo sit. The total payme nt amo unt deposited may no t re f l ect the gr oss income amoun t earn ed prior t o de ductions, includ ing various fees charged by a third- party incl uding a pplicatio n fees. Income verificatio n, such as a pa yst u b, physica l or electron ic earnin gs stat e ment, or notification of per-gig gr oss paymen t , must be requested from the appl icant or recipien t . For tax fil ing purpo ses, g ig-economy contractors wi ll receive IRS Form 1099-MISC for t o t a l services pe rf o rmed for t h e year. I f the customer states they want to use actual busin ess expenses but does not provid e verification, the deductio n w ould be zero. content: County of San Diego, Health and H u m an Ser vices Agency (HHSA ) CalFresh Program Guide Number Page Dependent Care D ed uction 63-23 3 1 of 2 Revision Date: 01/01/20 23 Back g r o und: CalFresh h ousehol ds (HH) may dedu ct dep endent care costs from their inco me t o d etermine Cal F re sh elig ibility. Purpose: There has be en no chang e in policy. This section is be ing updated d ue to sunset review. Poli c y: The depen dent ca re de duction is t h e actua l amo unt the HH pays for care for anothe r HH membe r that is un der the a ge of 18 or is of any age and inca pacitated re quiring care. For dep endent ca re dedu ct i ons only, i ncapacitation is define d as any permanent or t e mporary cond ition that pre vents the indi vidual from pa rt i cipating in n ormal a ct i vities in cluding , but not limited to, work or school withou t supervisi on to ensure the health and sa f e t y of the indivi dual, or a condition that ma kes a lack of supervi sion ri sky to the heal t h a nd safety of the i ndividua l. The HH is elig ible to de duct the dep endent care expenses f ro m t h eir income if depen dent care i s necessa ry f o r a HH me mber to search for employme nt, a ccept or continu e employme nt, comply with the C alFresh E m ployment a nd Traini ng (C F 1. Allow able Dep endent Care Expe nses Depe ndent ca re expe nses are only deductibl e if the service is pro vided by someon e outsid e the CalFresh HH and the HH makes an out-of-pocket payment for the service. The followin g exp enses are allo wable as de pendent care exp enses: The costs of care provide d by an indivi dual, provide r, or care f aci lity Transportatio n cost s to and from the care facility (standard Interna l Revenue Service [IRS] mileag e rate may be used ) Fees associa t e d with activities that are nece ssary f or the de penden t to partici pate in the care Example: Scenari o CalFresh H H consisting of mom, her 2 chil dren ages 9 and 4. Mom and the child ren li ve with grandma but do not purcha se and prepare meals w ith her. Mom is attendin g vocational scho ol to become a medi cal assistant. Grandma cares for the 4-year-o ld (y/ o ) w hile mom is at school and mom pays gran dma $400 per mon t h . Outcome HH w ould be allow ed a dep endent care deductio n of $400 per month si nce grand ma is not part of the C alFresh HH. Note: Preschoo l or any other type of schooli ng is not considere d a depend ent care expense. County of San Diego, Health and H u m an Ser vices Agency (HHSA ) CalFresh Program Guide Number Page Dependent Care D ed uction 63-23 3 2 of 2 2. When Dep endent Care D eduction is not all owed A d ependen t care deduction is not all owed to be claimed if another member o f the C alFresh HH provid es t h e care or when comp ensation for the care is provi ded in the form of an in-kin d benefit. The depe ndent care deduction will no t include any amoun t t ha t is covered by a subsid y or paid for by anothe r so urce on beha lf of the HH . Example: Scenari o CalFresh HH consistin g of mom a nd 3 child ren a ges 11 , 9, and 4 . Mom is attendin g voca t i onal school to be come a medi cal a ssistant. The 4 y/o goes to a licensed daycare cen t e r and the total cost is $1200 per month. Mom receive s a $1000 monthl y su bsidy for the childca re. Outcome The non-re imbursed sha re of co st for the chil dcare is $200 ($1 200 total cost - $1 000 sub sidy) therefore the HH would be allowed a de pendent care dedu ct i on of $200. Example: Scenari o CalFresh H H co nsisting of mom, h er 2 children age s 9 an d 4 an d grandma. Mom is attendin g vocational scho ol to become a medi cal assistant. Grandma cares for the 4 y/o whi le mom is at school and mom pays grandma $400 p er month. Outcome A d ependen t care deduction woul d no t be allowe d since grand ma is a member of the Cal F r esh HH. 3. Depe ndent Care Expe nses that May Q ua lify as Medical Expe nses Certain depe ndent care expense s may qu alify as either a medical expense or de pendent care expe nse. These exp enses may be counted as ei t h er, but not counted as both. Staff must classify the expen ses as medi cal or depe ndent care dep ending on which on e is more favorabl e to t h e HH. Refer to Section 63-23 2 f o r mo re information on Med ical Dedu ct i ons. content: County of Sa n Diego, Health and Human S e rvices Agency (HH SA) CalFresh Program Guide Number Page Substantial L otter y o r Gam b ling W inning s 63-24 7 1 of 2 Revision Date: 04/01/20 22 Back g r o und: Substantia l lottery or gamblin g winning s i s co nsidered a man datory mid-peri od report. Purpose: This sect i on de t a ils the reporting require ments and eligi bility rules for substantial lottery or gambli ng winn ings. I n f o rmation about substantia l lott e ry o r ga mbling wi nnings is bein g re moved from 63-283 and moved to 63-2 47. No change s are being made d ue to st ate legisl ation. Cl arification is bei ng ad ded regard ing the determi nation of substantia l lottery or ga mbling winni ngs w hen cu st o mers repo rt multipl e winn ings. Poli c y: Substantia l l ott e ry o r ga mbling wi nnings are defin ed as a ca sh prize won in a singl e game, purchase of a ticket, or similar bet. Substantial lottery or ga mbling winning s that are e qual to or greater tha n the elde rly or di sabled (E/ D ) resource limit wil l make a househ old (HH ) inelig ible to CalFresh. Sub st a ntial lottery o r gambli ng wi nnings must be rep orted wi t hi n 10 calenda r days o f receipt o f the win nings. Substantia l lottery or gamb ling winning s that are receive d prior to ini t i al ap plication do not nee d to be reported . Refer t o the CalFresh Assistance S tan dards Chart in Eligi bility Essentials f o r the current E/D resource l imit. 1. Determin ation of Substantial Lo t tery or Gambl ing Winnin gs: The do llar amou nt of the substantia l lottery or ga mbling winning s is determin ed before taxe s or any other w ithholdin g. Substantial l ot tery or gamblin g winni ngs should be evalu ated indivi dually a nd not combin ed or added together. If the HH member shared the wi nnings with a non-HH member, t h e portion all ocated t o the HH is the a mount tha t wil l be used to determine if the a mount e xceeds t h e E/D resource li mit. This requiremen t appl ies eve n if the H H imme diately spends or loses t he wi nnings, and the remain ing winn ings are belo w the E/ D resource limi t . Below is an example of substan t i al lottery or gambl ing winn ings determina t i on: Scenario: Customer rep orts t he f ol lowing w inning s to the coun t y. Custome r re ports t h at a ll winni ngs have been sp ent. Month Dollar Amount o f Winn ings August 15 $150 0 Septembe r 4 $100 0 Septembe r 1 0 $ 900 Septembe r 2 4 $140 0 October 5 $ 600 Outcome: County of Sa n Diego, Health and Human S e rvices Agency (HH SA) CalFresh Program Guide Number Page Substantial L otter y o r Gam b ling W inning s 63-24 7 2 of 2 Each winnin g wil l be evalua t e d indi viduall y and not combi ned. The customer d id no t exceed the E/D reso urce limi t of $3750 i n any on e winni ng. No action is requi red, case remai ns active. 2. Requ ired Action: When s u bstantial l ott e ry or gamb ling w innings are repo rt e d verify the winning s. I f the winni ngs are equa l to or greater than t he E/D resource limi t , discontin ue t he en t i re H H wi t h timel y notice . A verba l decla ration of w inning s is acceptab le, a nd no verification will be ne cessary. Staff must do cument t h e decla ration in t h e case reco rd. A HH discontinu ed f or the receipt of substantial lottery or ga mbling winn ings w ill remain inelig ible until t h e HH s inco me and resource s do not e xceed the resource and income limits. 3. Reap plication After Disco ntinuance : HH s discontinu ed due to receipt of substan t i al lottery or gambling winnin gs may reap ply for CalFre sh at any time. HH reapp lying wil l not be conside red Categorica lly Eligib le (CE) or Modified-C ategorical ly Eligi ble (MCE). The CalFresh gross i ncome, ne t income and resource test must be ap plied. This requi rement onl y appl ies the f i rst t i me a H H is ce rt i f i ed follo wing t he discon t i nuance f o r substantial lottery or gamblin g winn ings, regard less of the length of t i me between the disco ntinuance and reapp lication. At the time of reap plication , i f the HH composi t i on has chan ged, this wil l be consi dered a d istinctly different HH than t h e on e that was previou sly di scontinued due to substantial lottery or gamblin g winn ings. St a f f wil l process this as a regular Cal F re sh applicatio n and not apply the substantia l l ott e ry or ga mbling w inning policie s. T hi s includ es when t he primary an d sole a pplican t i s the recipi ent of the substantia l lottery or gamblin g winning s. Note: S taff must use B EN DS 592 82 wh en a case mu st be d iscontinue d or when a HH reappli es after bein g discontinu ed due to substantial l ot tery or ga mbling wi nnings until t he syst em i s up dated. 4. Informing HH o f Re porting Requ irement: Staff must verbally inform new an d existing H Hs of the substan t i al lottery and g ambling winning s reportin g requ irement during t h e in itial cert i f i cation and rece rt i f i cation interview. The information on t hi s new reporting req uirement is pa rt of t he recorded ri ghts and respo nsibili t i es. Confirmation t ha t t he HH was verba lly informed of the substan t i al lottery or gambli ng winnin gs reporting requ irement must be docume nted in case record .
